description:
We’re a group of motivated students from KTECH and KETCH excited to take on challenges, share ideas, and build something amazing together at NASA Space Apps Challenge!

We’re looking for creative, passionate, and team-oriented students with skills in coding, design, research, science, or problem-solving. Most importantly, we value teamwork, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

Open exclusively to KTECH and KETCH students. Let’s learn, create, and make an impact together!
